annotations.text:
Restyling nsscode.com.
Top row = what's live today (bare Tailwind zinc).
Bottom row = three directions.

Pick one and I'll build it in the real Tailwind.
A — Warm, light, editorial. Serif headings, soft cards, the most literal read of a café palette.
B — Same warmth, kept dark. Roasted browns instead of cold zinc; amber accent. Closest to what you have now.
C — Borrows the dashboard skeleton: sidebar nav, side-by-side panels. Denser, more utilitarian.
